note: פתרס records the consonantal stem of the gentilic. No Hebrew verbal derivation is established.
summary: פַּתְרֻסִים names the people of Pathros. Genesis and Chronicles both place them between the Naphtuhim and the Casluhim among the descendants of Mizraim.

senses.definition: A people associated with the Egyptian region of Pathros and counted among the descendants of Mizraim.

evidence.note: Mizraim is the subject of יָלַד, and וְאֶת introduces the Pathrusim as one of the peoples he fathered.
The parallel genealogy places the Pathrusim immediately before the Casluhim.
The related place name appears in אֶרֶץ פַּתְרוֹס, the land of Pathros, among the places in Egypt where Judeans lived.
